candidate.title: Bulk follow creators from liked content
candidate.applicability: Authenticated media-library tasks where liked items expose nested creators and follow endpoints exist; use after login and respect pagination limits.
procedure: Inspect API docs to identify login, liked-item, follow-status, and follow-action endpoints.
Authenticate and retain the returned access token for authorized calls.
Fetch all liked items by paginating with the maximum allowed page size until an empty or short page appears.
Extract creator identifiers from each item, deduplicating by stable ID rather than display name.
Fetch current followed creators with the same pagination pattern and build an already-followed ID set.
Follow only missing IDs and capture per-item success or failure.
Re-fetch the followed list and verify every target ID is present before completion.
pitfalls: Do not treat the first page as complete; default limits may be small.
Do not match creators by name; use IDs and handle multiple creators per item.
Do not assume mutations succeeded without a post-action read.
Do not call private endpoints without a valid token.
